title: Small Bathroom Ideas for Nairobi Apartments
excerpt: Practical layout and fitting ideas to make the most of compact bathrooms common in Nairobi apartment developments.
author: Grace Mutua
seoDescription: Practical small bathroom design ideas for Nairobi apartments, including space-saving fixtures and layout tips from Maven Enterprise Ltd.
content:
Compact bathrooms are a reality in most Nairobi apartment developments, but smart fixture choices can make a small space feel considerably larger.

Wall-hung toilets and basins free up visible floor space and make cleaning easier — a small change that has an outsized visual impact in tight bathrooms.

Frameless glass shower enclosures, rather than bulky shower curtains or tiled dividers, keep sightlines open and let light travel through the room.

Light-coloured, large-format tiles reduce the number of grout lines, which visually enlarges a compact bathroom, while a well-placed mirrored cabinet adds storage without consuming floor area.

Our bathroom renovation team can assess your specific layout and recommend fittings that maximise both function and visual space.

title: Kitchen Inspiration for Modern Kenyan Homes
excerpt: Cabinet styles, countertop materials and layout ideas for a kitchen that's as functional as it is beautiful.

coverImage.alt: Modern kitchen with green cabinetry and stone countertop

author: Faith Achieng
seoDescription: Kitchen design inspiration for modern Kenyan homes, covering cabinet styles, countertop materials and layout planning from Maven Enterprise Ltd.
content:
A well-planned kitchen layout starts with the classic 'work triangle' between sink, stove and refrigerator — even in smaller Kenyan kitchen footprints, keeping this triangle efficient makes daily cooking far more pleasant.

Handleless cabinetry continues to be a popular choice for a clean, modern look, while shaker-style cabinets suit homeowners after a more classic aesthetic.

When it comes to countertops, engineered quartz offers a non-porous, low-maintenance surface that resists staining from common kitchen use, while natural granite remains a favourite for its unique character.

Don't overlook the kitchen sink and mixer tap — a granite composite sink paired with a pull-down spray mixer adds both durability and everyday convenience.

Our kitchen installation service coordinates cabinetry, countertops and fittings as a single project, so everything is measured and fitted to work together.

title: Flooring Guide: Vinyl vs SPC vs Laminate — Which Is Right for You?
excerpt: A practical comparison of Kenya's three most popular modern flooring options to help you choose confidently.

coverImage.alt: Warm wooden vinyl flooring in a living room

author: Brian Kiplagat
seoDescription: Compare vinyl, SPC and laminate flooring for Kenyan homes and commercial spaces — durability, cost and installation guidance from Maven Enterprise Ltd.
content:
Vinyl flooring is fully waterproof and comes in realistic wood and stone finishes, making it a strong choice for bathrooms, kitchens and high-moisture areas.

SPC (stone-plastic composite) flooring takes waterproofing a step further with a rigid core that resists dents and temperature changes, making it ideal for commercial spaces and busy households.

Laminate flooring remains the most budget-friendly option with a genuine wood-look finish, though it is less moisture-tolerant than vinyl or SPC and is best suited to living rooms and bedrooms.

Installation matters as much as material choice — proper subfloor levelling and acclimatisation prevent the gapping and lifting that cause most flooring complaints.

Our flooring installation team can advise on the right product for each room based on foot traffic, moisture exposure and budget.

title: 5 Things to Sort Out Before You Start a Home Renovation
excerpt: Avoid common renovation pitfalls with this pre-project checklist from our project management team.
author: Brian Kiplagat
seoDescription: Essential renovation planning tips before starting your home renovation project in Kenya, from Maven Enterprise Ltd's project management team.
content:
Before any renovation begins, set a realistic budget that includes a 10-15% contingency for unexpected site conditions — older Nairobi homes in particular can reveal plumbing or wall surprises once work begins.

Agree on a clear scope of work in writing, including material specifications, so there's no ambiguity about what's included in your quotation.

Plan for where you'll live during the works, especially for kitchen and bathroom renovations that temporarily affect essential facilities.

Order long-lead-time items — such as made-to-order cabinetry or imported fittings — early, so installation isn't held up waiting on materials.

Finally, choose a single accountable contractor or project manager rather than coordinating multiple trades yourself; it significantly reduces scheduling conflicts and finger-pointing when issues arise.

title: Buying Guide: How to Choose the Right Sanitary Ware
excerpt: What to look for when selecting toilets, basins and bathtubs for durability and water efficiency.
author: Linda Wafula
seoDescription: A practical buying guide for choosing toilets, basins and bathtubs in Kenya, covering water efficiency, materials and warranty considerations.
content:
Water efficiency should be a top consideration — dual-flush toilets using 3-6 litres per flush use significantly less water than older single-flush models, an important factor given variable water supply in many areas.

Check the glaze quality on ceramic ware; a smooth, high-quality glaze resists staining and is easier to keep clean over the fixture's lifetime.

For basins, consider your vanity space — wall-mounted and slimline basins suit compact bathrooms, while countertop basins offer a striking design statement in larger spaces.

When choosing a bathtub, factor in your hot water system's capacity; a large freestanding tub will need a water heater sized to fill it comfortably.

Always confirm warranty terms and installation compatibility before purchasing, and ask our team for guidance matching fittings to your existing plumbing configuration.

title: 7 Interior Design Trends Shaping Kenyan Homes in 2026
excerpt: From warm minimalism to statement wall panelling, here are the interior trends we're seeing across Nairobi and beyond this year.
content:
Kenyan homeowners are embracing a warmer, more textured take on minimalism this year, moving away from stark all-white interiors toward earthy tones, natural materials and statement wall features.

Decorative wall panelling — particularly 3D textured and wood-effect PVC panels — continues to be one of the most requested finishes we install, offering a high-impact feature wall without the cost of full remodelling.

In kitchens, we're seeing a shift toward deep emerald and charcoal cabinetry paired with warm brass hardware, replacing the all-white kitchens that dominated the last decade.

Sustainability is also front of mind: SPC and vinyl flooring remain popular for their durability and lower long-term replacement costs compared to traditional materials, especially in Nairobi's variable climate.

Whatever direction you're leaning, our design consultants can help you translate these trends into a material palette that suits your specific space and budget.
